definitions: Social insects that live in colonies, are related to cockroaches, and are known for their destructive feeding habits on wood and other cellulose-containing materials.
A soft-bodied, pale-colored insect that lives in large colonies, typically in tropical or subtropical regions, and feeds on wood, causing extensive damage to trees and wooden structures.
examples: The house was infested with termites.
Termites can cause significant structural damage.
A termite mound can be quite large.
